candidates.tagline: Sydney Marathon medal features a German stadium instead of Sydney's
candidates.story: The 2026 Sydney Marathon finisher medal depicts the Munich Allianz Arena instead of Sydney's Allianz Stadium — designers apparently Googled 'Allianz stadium' and grabbed the wrong continent's iconic venue.
candidates.why_funny: Every finisher of the Sydney Marathon received a medal celebrating a German building, and organisers' response was that it's now 'a little more unique.'
candidates.alt: Sydney Marathon 2026 finisher medal showing the distinctive diamond-patterned Allianz Arena from Munich, Germany, instead of the Sydney stadium

candidates.tagline: HONOR's $1,930 phone sprouts a robot arm to hold its own camera
candidates.story: HONOR launched the 'Robot Phone,' a $1,930 smartphone with a mechanical folding gimbal arm that pops out of the back so the camera can stabilize itself — solving camera shake by adding a robot appendage to your pocket.
candidates.why_funny: The logical conclusion of 'we added AI stabilization' is apparently just strapping a physical robot arm to the outside of the phone.
candidates.alt: The HONOR Robot Phone with its mechanical gimbal arm extended, holding the camera module aloft on a folding robotic appendage
